WITH j AS (
  SELECT P.ID AS pid, P.SEX AS sex, L.PT AS pt, L.ALB - L.TP AS ad
  FROM Laboratory L JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID
),
g AS (
  SELECT pid, sex, AVG(pt) AS pt_avg, AVG(ad) AS ad_avg
  FROM j GROUP BY pid, sex
),
o AS (
  SELECT AVG(pt_avg) AS overall FROM g
)
SELECT g.sex, AVG(g.pt_avg) AS avg_pt, AVG(g.ad_avg) AS avg_alb_minus_tp, AVG(g.pt_avg - o.overall) AS avg_pt_diff
FROM g CROSS JOIN o
WHERE o.overall IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY g.sex
ORDER BY g.sex
